_doc: Source of the side rail that sync-rail.js injects into every grafana/dashboards/*.json.

This folder is NOT provisioned (Grafana loads every .json under grafana/dashboards/ as a dashboard), so the rail lives here and is copied into the dashboards. Edit it here, then run: node grafana/rail/sync-rail.js (check without writing: --check).

nav: the dashboards in the navigation panel, in display order. uid = dashboard uid, idBase = first panel id of that dashboard's rail block. The active item is baked into each dashboard's HTML (the panel has the native title Dashboards). A new dashboard = one entry here plus a sync run.

Panel ids: the rail owns ids 300-399. Each dashboard gets the block idBase..idBase+9 and panel id = idBase + idOffset (nav +0, usage bargauge +1, most-frequent-tip stat +2, tips-count stat +3; +4 and +5 (the removed header text panels) are unused and reserved). Blocks: Overview 300, Sessions 310, Prompts 320, Efficiency 330, Agents 340, Tools 350, Health 360 (370 was Tips, merged into Efficiency; do not reuse). sync-rail.js deletes every panel with an id in 300-399 before injecting, so never use that range for content panels. Ids 1-299 and 400-499 are the dashboards' own content panels (hint rows, section headers, stats, tables, charts; see modules/dashboard.md).

Layout: x=0, w=3 (railW); content starts at x=3 and is 21 columns wide. Panels stack from y=0 in the order below; every panel has a fixed positive integer gridPos.h. Navigation is not transparent (same panel background as the others). Every rail panel has a native Grafana title (Dashboards, Usage · last 5 h, Tips · 7 d, the last has none); h 1 header text panels do not work because the HTML sanitizer strips line-height and overflow. Heights: navigation 12, usage 4, tips count 3, most frequent 3 (two stat panels because a stat applies one font size to all its fields; the second has no title). Panels stack in the array order, not by idOffset. The empty dashboard background below the rail is intended. Navigation h = 12 fits the 7 items without a scrollbar (the Efficiency hint wraps to two lines); the tips panels link to Efficiency (Tips section).
Usage and tips ignore the dashboard time range and the variables on purpose (fixed windows in SQL; tips use cc.tips, fixed 7 days).

panels.title: Dashboards
panels.description: Navigation. Links keep the time range and the variables.

panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'cache-rewrite', 'Cache rewrites', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)
